risk_description: Trustees require mitigation exceeding what the transaction can bear
cause: Veridia is a smaller and more leveraged sponsor than Narwhal; acquisition debt ranks ahead of the scheme
consequence: Transaction does not complete; GBP 1.85M diligence cost written off
mitigation: Early private approach to independent trustee chair; seek TPR clearance; model GBP 7.2M as planning assumption; Board to set walk-away number before negotiations

risk_description: Dr Isobel Hartland-Vose (Narwhal CTO) leaves within 18 months
cause: Receives GBP 1.9M on completion; highly marketable; four credible competitor destinations
consequence: Acquisition rationale fails - the mechanical engineering capability is substantially her
mitigation: GBP 250k retention over 24 months; Veridia equity; genuine ExCo role as group CTO; CEO to meet her personally before signing

risk_description: Priya Anand (Veridia Head of Field Service) resigns
cause: Approached by executive search Q2 2026; field service integration being planned without her; would learn she was excluded
consequence: Loss of the person holding together a function already subject to a stress risk assessment; field service integration fails
mitigation: Bring inside the tent before Gate 2 (HR DD R8); off-cycle adjustment already made OCA-2026-011; named integration workstream lead

risk_description: Terms harmonisation cost cancels the synergy case
cause: Narwhal terms materially below Veridia's across pension leave medical sick pay and family leave
consequence: Transaction economics fundamentally different from the model presented at Gate 1
mitigation: Re-model at Gate 2 with option (c) phased harmonisation GBP 1.9M year one rising to GBP 3.13M; present revised synergy to Board; justify transaction on strategic case alone

risk_description: IR35 and employment status exposure crystallises
cause: 34 contractors engaged as self-employed; at least 26 very likely employees; no status determinations since April 2021; ACAS claim live
consequence: GBP 1.91M HMRC exposure plus employment rights claims; penalties increase if finding is deliberate
mitigation: Specific uncapped indemnity; GBP 2.5M escrow for 4 years; conduct provisions over the ACAS claim; employ the 26 properly at completion

risk_description: Veridia's people culture is degraded rather than transmitted
cause: Acquiring an organisation 29% larger with weaker practices and 2.4x the turnover; acquirer culture does not reliably prevail when the target is bigger
consequence: Loss of the employee proposition that underpins Veridia's retention; slow and largely invisible for 18 months then irreversible
mitigation: Named executive owner for culture integration with budget reporting to Board quarterly for 3 years; engagement survey at 90 days published to both populations; harmonise upwards quickly and visibly

risk_description: Post-completion internal reorganisation triggers TUPE unexpectedly
cause: Share purchase means no TUPE at completion; integration teams assume TUPE was 'done' and it was never engaged
consequence: Failure to inform and consult; protective awards of up to 13 weeks' pay per affected employee
mitigation: Each post-completion reorganisation treated as a separate TUPE event with its own analysis; briefed to integration leads; Marchmont Sayers retained

risk_description: Wroclaw collective agreement makes modelled synergy value-destructive
cause: Severance 3-4x statutory; consultation obligations; restriction on outsourcing; survives change of control
consequence: GBP 551k severance against GBP 398k annual saving; union relationship damaged at a site with 31% turnover
mitigation: Remove OV-16 from the synergy model entirely; public commitment plus capital investment at Wroclaw; engage Solidarnosc pre-signing

risk_description: Right to work compliance gap inherited at completion
cause: Sample testing found evidence attached in only 22 of 40 records; up to 130 UK employees may have no evidence on file
consequence: Civil penalty up to GBP 60000 per worker; 60-day clock from transfer to complete own checks
mitigation: Scoped day-one verification exercise budgeted at GBP 28k; two temporary resources; must complete within 60 days; warranty and disclosure

risk_description: Special category health data held unlawfully in free-text HRIS fields
cause: Line managers entering diagnoses medication and consultant names into an unstructured absence notes field; 14 of 60 sampled records affected; retained indefinitely
consequence: ICO exposure; reputational damage if surfaced through a subject access request post-completion
mitigation: Disable the free-text field on day one; retention policy applied; manager training; DPIA and ROPA created

risk_description: Transaction leaks before signing
cause: Speculation already present - 4 of 13 H2 2025 exit interviews referenced rumours unprompted; FAQ carries an acquisition question; 14 people plus advisers inside
consequence: Price impact; employee anxiety; Ardenmoor may withdraw; competitive response
mitigation: Annex A maintained by GC with CFO approval for additions; codenames in all external-facing references; no target name in calendar entries travel or expenses; personal confidentiality undertakings

risk_description: Management attention diverted from the 2026 operating plan
cause: Six of nine ExCo members materially engaged; IVDR certification submission in parallel
consequence: IVDR certification slips; FY2026 plan missed; CSO attributes both to Unicorn
mitigation: CEO monitors monthly; IVDR workstream ringfenced from deal team demands; Sarah Lindgren's limited brief resolved by 2026-07-31

risk_description: Revenue synergy of GBP 1.2M does not materialise
cause: Assumes displacement of competitor analysers in 190 Narwhal laboratories over 5-7 years; no evidenced displacement rate
consequence: Transaction returns below model; Board approved on a case that did not hold
mitigation: Management not asking Board to underwrite revenue synergy; Board explicitly required an honest reassessment at Gate 2; transaction justified on capability case alone

risk_description: Narwhal payroll server out of support January 2027
cause: Access Dimensions on Windows Server 2016; extended support ends 2027-01; no migration plan; deadline falls between signing and completion
consequence: Payroll for 265 people on an unsupported platform; single-site backup with no tested offsite copy
mitigation: Require Narwhal to remediate before completion at their cost as a condition; UK payroll consolidation onto Veridia provider as Phase 2 priority

risk_description: Narwhal mechanical engineering team departs as a cluster
cause: 26 people average tenure 7.4 years; engineering teams leave following a leader; linked to UNI-RSK-002
mitigation: Retain Hartland-Vose; harmonise this team's terms at completion rather than over 36 months (GBP 310k pa); give them the SP-1r2 tolerance problem in month one

risk_description: Equal pay claim NAR-ET-002 succeeds and produces contagion
cause: Narwhal has no job evaluation scheme no equal pay audit and a 21.4% mean gender pay gap
consequence: Multiple further claims from the same grade; quantum unbounded; inherited by Veridia
mitigation: Specific indemnity; require disclosure of any settlement terms before signing; job evaluation exercise as a post-completion priority

risk_description: Employee on long-term sick leave receives transaction communication without support
cause: Veridia case OH-2026-003 (Basel QC) and unknown equivalent cases at Narwhal; employees on long-term absence retain full consultation rights
consequence: Indefensible treatment of a seriously ill employee; reputational and legal exposure
mitigation: CPO personally checks all long-term absence cases before any organisational communication is issued - already recorded as a watch item on the case file; equivalent list to be obtained from Narwhal at completion

risk_description: Role overlap model reaches employees
cause: Document names functions with 'DIRECT OVERLAP' and 'High' assessments against real teams; would be read as a redundancy list
consequence: Catastrophic loss of trust in both populations; would invalidate the entire communications plan
mitigation: Restricted to deal team; not circulated by email; watermarked; explicitly listed in the communications plan as the one document that must never leave the tent
